name: Vine Deloria Jr.
shortBio: Standing Rock Sioux philosopher, theologian, and legal theorist; author of God Is Red and Custer Died for Your Sins, establishing Indigenous spatial metaphysics, treaty rights, and relational ontology against Western linear progressivism.
centralQuestion: Why must the Western obsession with linear time and universal teleology be abandoned in favor of a spatial, place-based relational metaphysics rooted in sacred geography?

keyWorks.title: Custer Died for Your Sins: An Indian Manifesto
keyWorks.description: Foundational manifesto of the Red Power movement, critiquing anthropology, Christian missionization, and federal assimilationist policies.

keyWorks.title: God Is Red: A Native View of Religion
keyWorks.description: Philosophical masterwork contrasting spatial Native American metaphysics and reverence for sacred lands with temporal Western historical teleology.

keyWorks.title: The Metaphysics of Modern Existence
keyWorks.description: Cross-cultural metaphysical inquiry synthesizing indigenous epistemology with modern physics and process philosophy.
